stops.title: Wo nhyehyɛeɛ
stops.caption: Akawnt, ahobammɔ, ne sɛdeɛ ɛyɛ.
stops.speech: Nhyehyɛeɛ fa w’akawnt, akwan a wonam so hyɛ mu, sɛdeɛ Kairos yɛ, ne kasa a ɔde kasa kyerɛ wo.

stops.title: Amanneɛbɔ
stops.caption: Deɛ ɛduru wo nkyɛn, ne mpɛn ahe.
stops.speech: Amanneɛbɔ yɛ ɛkuo biara dea. Yi ntɛm ara anaa daa nsɛm tiawa ma biara, anaa dum no. Ahobammɔ kɔkɔbɔ deɛ, ɛba daa.
